name: Tachibana Akira
source: The only daughter of the Tachibana family and a samurai working for the Empire. She hates men because of her past: her family looked down on her because she wasn't born as a man.
translation: The only daughter of the Tachibana family and a samurai working for the Empire. She hates men because of her past: her family looked down on her because she wasn't born as a man.
